claim_001.label: SUPPORTED
claim_001.text: Text.expand_tabs calculates tab stops independently for each line by resetting the cell position when processing every line that contains a tab.

evidence.note: The frozen implementation initializes cell_position to zero inside the per-line tab-processing branch and calculates each tab remainder from that line-local cell position.
The multiline tab-expansion tests verify independent expansion after newline boundaries.

claim_001.rationale: The line-local cell_position initialization and multiline regression cases directly establish that tab stops are recalculated for each line.

claim_002.label: SUPPORTED
claim_002.text: Text.expand_tabs preserves and extends style spans when replacing tabs with spaces, including styled text containing double-width characters.

evidence.note: The frozen implementation expands styled parts with extend_style, joins the transformed Text objects, and replaces the original spans with the resulting spans.
The parameterized tests verify the exact expanded text and Span ranges for styled tabs, multiline text, and double-width characters.
The changelog states that Text.expand_tabs not expanding spans was fixed.

claim_002.rationale: The source transfers spans from the joined expanded result, while the regression tests and changelog independently document span preservation across tab expansion.

claim_003.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_003.text: The tab-expansion change was primarily introduced to reduce Rich's memory usage.
claim_003.rationale: The frozen source, tests, commit sequence, and changelog focus on tab positioning and style-span correctness rather than memory reduction.

claim_004.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_004.text: The change adds a new Rich markup syntax for representing tab characters.
claim_004.rationale: The change modifies internal Text tab expansion and style-span handling without adding or changing Rich markup syntax.
